items.reasons: Mostly a flat front view: the pink header and glass case go straight down with only about 1–2 rows of top surface, unlike the deep lit tops on the originals' cooler and desk.

Mostly dithered charcoal-grey blocks with little value separation, so the lid, fallboard and lower panel blur together. That dark mass is off-palette next to the originals' clean flat shading, and the gold pedal bits look like stickers.
Lit wood top of about 3+ rows, a clear 3x3 grid of small doors with handles, wood palette and outline that match the wardrobe original, and it sits on the floor believably.

The pink and green products are uneven chunky blobs with stray single pixels rather than readable packs, and the pink base stripe is noisy. Pixel density is coarser than the cooler original's neat bottle rows.
Grey top plane, teal header, glass doors with readable bouquets in buckets and a dark vent base. Outline and shading match the cooler original, and it stands on the floor against the wall.

A flat front view of a pegboard with almost no top surface. The hanging goods are scattered single-colour specks (red, blue, green ring, black) that look noisy and float on the board rather than hanging from pegs.
The top plank is only about 1–2 rows thick and reads as a front frame edge, not a lit top plane. It's a flat front view of an open shelf, not the deeper top seen on the wardrobe and cooler originals.
Grey top plane with a blue band and coin unit, a grid of locker doors with keyholes and small coloured tags, a palette that fits the filing-cabinet original, and a clean floor contact.

The green body with a dark screen and slot reads as a robot face or mailbox rather than an IC card fare-charging machine. There's no card reader or panel, and the waist pinch makes it look like a figure.
Drawn as a 1-tile-high post standing below the wall line, when a station pillar should run floor to ceiling. In the room it reads as a bollard, so the scale is wrong for the object.
Grey top plane, rows of coloured drink samples, a red header, a payment panel and a dispenser slot. Outline and density match the originals, and it stands flush on the floor.
Pure front facade with no top plane. Two clothed mannequins in the window and a generic 'SHOP' sign make it read as a clothing store, not an arcade.
Light grey top plane, two stacked units with round blue doors, dials and vents. The appliance-white palette and outline fit the desk-pc and register originals, and it is grounded on the floor.

The mirror frame on top is narrower than the counter and sticks up like a separate piece on a stalk. The scissors and dryer on the counter are thin, high-contrast sticker pixels, and the mirror's wall part overlaps the wall stripe outside the cabinet's footprint.
The upper teal detergent shelf sits in a black backing box that floats above the washers with a dark gap, so it reads as detached from the floor unit. The bottles are blocky sticker colours.
A luggage rack is an overhead train fixture, but here it stands on the floor as a cabinet with poster panels below. The suitcase and bag sit on top, so it reads as a shop display, not a luggage rack.
